commits.message: TASK-0056: drop nativeVirtualKeyCode from e2e pressKey
TASK-0056: collapsible, resizable sidebar and chat panel

events.text: The branch looks coherent. Now running both evals.
Both pass. The branch changed `prelude.js`, so I also ran `help-a11y` to check that suite still works with it:

I reviewed the branch and both evals pass, but I haven't merged `main` into it yet. `git merge` isn't one of the git commands I'm allowed to run here, so that step is still open.

**Review of the branch (commits 71867d9, caf3f05, 2a2577e)**
- **Saved layout:** `web/src/state/panels.tsx` holds the sidebar and chat widths and the sidebar's collapsed state. It keeps them within the allowed ranges (sidebar 200–480 px, chat 320–720 px) and shrinks the panels, chat first, so the main area never drops below 480 px. Defaults are 270 px and 410 px, and the collapsed rail is 40 px. The layout is saved in the browser under `reqforge.panels` (`web/src/lib/storage.ts`), not per project, so it survives project switches. The chat's open/closed state reuses the existing `reqforge.chat.open` setting.
- **Resize handle:** `web/src/components/PanelHandle.tsx` is a focusable separator with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`. It resizes by drag, by arrow keys in 16 px steps, and by Home/End. Enter collapses the panel and double-clicking restores the default width. It is hidden below the lg breakpoint.
- **Sidebar and chat:** the sidebar collapses to a rail with an expand button. The chat's × collapses it and the header Chat button (`id="chat-toggle"`, `aria-expanded`) reopens it. After a collapse, focus moves to the control that brings the panel back.
- **Layout:** `App.tsx` now sets the column widths from these values instead of fixed ones. Below lg the existing slide-out sheet and full-screen chat are unchanged.
- **Suites and help:** the `panels` and `panels-a11y` suites are registered in `run.mjs`, and `web/help/01-browse-and-filter.md` has a new section explaining the controls.
- I found nothing that needs fixing.

**Evals**
- E1: `node web/e2e/run.mjs --junit web/e2e/results/junit-panels.xml --suite panels` passed 48/48 checks (REQ-0064 AC1, AC2, AC4, AC5).
- E2: `node web/e2e/run.mjs --junit web/e2e/results/junit-panels-a11y.xml --suite panels-a11y` passed 29/29 checks (AC3).
- I also ran `--suite help-a11y` because the branch changed `web/e2e/lib/prelude.js`; it passed 20/20.

There was nothing new to commit. The staged files under `requirements/` were already there and belong to reqforge, so I left them alone.

**Left open**
- **Merge `main` into the branch.** I expect only `web/e2e/lib/prelude.js` to conflict. On `main`, da05f0f makes the same `nativeVirtualKeyCode` fix as this branch's 2a2577e. The branch version also adds the End, Home and arrow key codes the panels suites need, so keep the branch's version (`git checkout --ours web/e2e/lib/prelude.js`). The other commits on `main` are reqforge bookkeeping in `requirements/`. After merging, rerun E1 and E2.

NEXT: Run `git merge main` on reqforge/TASK-0056, resolve web/e2e/lib/prelude.js with `git checkout --ours`, commit, then rerun the panels and panels-a11y e2e suites.
